definitions.explanation: refers to any person without exception, or all people in a given context

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}でも⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{誰|だれ}でも⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{誰|だれ}でも⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want anyone at all to help me.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧ (who) + ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ (even, any)

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ~⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ pattern creates "any-" words:
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - anything
- {何処|どこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - anywhere
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - anytime
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - either one

USAGE:
- With positive: "anyone can" → universal possibility
- With negative: "not anyone" → nobody
- {誰|だれ}でも⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ - anyone is fine (indifference)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誰|だれ}でも (anyone/everyone) ↔ ⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧ (someone)
- {誰|だれ}でも (anyone/everyone) ↔ ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧ + neg (no one)
